title: Incorporation and names
text:
This guide includes information and advice about:

 • how to incorporate a limited company

 • the type of company you wish to incorporate

 • the company’s officers

 • choosing a company name including controls and restrictions

 • disclosure of company name and other information

 If you use your home address as your service address or the company’s registered office, it will be available to the public.

 See our guidance on what information we make publicly available .
changeNote: Updated wording under 'Annex A - 87. Ombudsman' to clarify that the list of requirements only applies to non-statutory bodies.

attachments.title: Annex A: Sensitive words and expressions that require prior approval to use in a company or business name
